prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='rf', recommended_method='best_single_by_validation'. Narrative: The random forest (rf) model dominates across all dimensions: perfect trend correlation (1.0), highest seasonal correlation (0.6894), and lowest RMSE (53.477). With stable rankings (Kendall τ=0.6023) and clear superiority over the second-best model (ONLY_FT_catboost at 57.31 RMSE), rf is the clear champion. Despite high model disagreement (rmse_spread_ratio=24.83), the consistent pattern capture and performance stability justify selecting rf as the single best model rather than combining with inferior alternatives.
